quotes.text: Using latent space for thinking is an obvious idea and has been known for ages — the frontier labs avoided an arms race in this direction due to interpretability and alignment concerns.
quotes.author: sznio
quotes.source: Hacker News — Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
quotes.extraction_note: Highlights the uncomfortable tension between what's technically obvious and what's deliberately avoided for safety reasons.
